flags.name: DSV41_MOE_ROUTEPREP
flags.meaning: Target MoE layers (E384 top-6 H5120, M32 path, mfront serving) defer the FC1-input quant from prepare() and run _dsv41_rp_kernel instead of per_token_group_quant_8bit + _dsv41_fp_plan_kernel + _dsv41_fp_scatter_kernel. Ineligible calls (M > 96, other geometry) quantize in apply() with the identical prepare() call. Unset/0/off/false: nothing imported, nothing changed. At the first eligible call (eager profile/warm-up run) the process precompiles all 5 SLOTS buckets of the variant in use (Triton JITFunction.warmup, no launch); any compile error turns the fused path OFF for the process (logged 'fused route prep OFF (precompile failed: ...)') and every call takes today's prepare() quant.

flags.name: DSV41_MOE_FC1_FRONT
flags.meaning: Read only when DSV41_MOE_ROUTEPREP=1 (otherwise inert). pdl: the fused kernel triggers its PDL dependents (FC1) right after its gdc_wait. pfN: pdl + prefetch.global.L2 of the first N FC1 k-blocks (64 B each) of every weight row and the matching w1_scale words of each selected expert, issued once per expert by its first route. Invalid value: ValueError at import.
